description: External scientific resources for the Resource Library. Descriptions are original. Link-check fields are written by tools/freshwater-portal/check-links.mjs; a link that fails an automated check is flagged for administrator review, never silently replaced.

records.title: Harmful Algal Blooms
records.organization: Kentucky Energy and Environment Cabinet, Division of Water
records.description: Kentucky's official harmful algal bloom (HAB) program page: how the state monitors blooms, current recreational advisories, safety guidance for people and animals, and how to report a suspected bloom.
records.primary_use: Current Kentucky HAB advisories and reporting

records.title: Kentucky Water Maps Portal
records.organization: Kentucky Energy and Environment Cabinet, Division of Water
records.description: Entry point to the Division of Water's web map applications, including watershed and water-health viewers and the HAB viewer. Start here to see which state map tools exist before searching for a dataset.
records.primary_use: Finding the right state water map application

records.title: Kentucky Watershed Explorer
records.description: Interactive viewer for exploring Kentucky watersheds and the environmental and water-resource layers mapped within them. Useful for placing a stream such as Allen Branch inside its hydrologic units.
records.primary_use: Exploring watershed units and mapped water-resource layers

records.title: GIS Maps & Resources
records.organization: Kentucky Energy and Environment Cabinet, Division of Water
records.description: The Division of Water's catalog of downloadable GIS data and map services for hydrology, water quality and permitting in Kentucky.

records.title: Water Quality Monitoring
records.organization: Kentucky Energy and Environment Cabinet, Division of Water
records.description: Kentucky's surface-water monitoring programs, water-quality assessments and Integrated Reports, which state whether assessed waters support their designated uses.
records.primary_use: State monitoring programs and assessment reports

records.title: Information on Blue-Green Algae and Harmful Algae Blooms
records.organization: Kentucky Department of Fish & Wildlife Resources
records.description: Public guidance for anglers and boaters on cyanobacteria ("blue-green algae") in Kentucky lakes, including what blooms look like and how to reduce exposure for people, pets and harvested fish.
records.primary_use: Public education on blooms in Kentucky lakes

records.title: Kentucky Geological Survey
records.organization: Kentucky Geological Survey, University of Kentucky
records.description: State geological survey: geologic maps, groundwater and water-well data, karst and sinkhole mapping, and springs. Essential for south-central Kentucky, where limestone karst can route water underground in ways surface maps do not show.
records.check_detail: The automated check could not connect (SSL certificate problem: unable to get local issuer certificate); confirm in a browser

records.title: Kentucky Geography Network (KyGeoNet)
records.organization: Commonwealth Office of Technology, Division of Geographic Information
records.description: Kentucky's clearinghouse for geospatial data and web map services — hydrography, hydrologic units, land cover, imagery, roads and more.

records.title: KyFromAbove
records.description: Statewide aerial imagery and lidar-derived elevation data. High-resolution terrain models make small stream channels, valleys and sinkholes visible, which helps interpret where water can flow.

records.title: KyGovMaps Open Data Portal
records.description: Searchable catalog of downloadable Kentucky geographic datasets and web services (shapefile, GeoJSON, CSV and API access).

records.title: Kentucky Mesonet
records.description: Statewide network of research-grade weather stations. Use it to document recent rainfall and air temperature for a field visit instead of estimating them.
records.primary_use: Recent rainfall and weather for field observations

records.title: StreamStats
records.description: Web application that delineates the drainage basin upstream of a clicked point and reports basin characteristics and, where regression equations exist, streamflow statistics. The tool for the Allen Branch upstream-drainage task.

records.title: The National Map Viewer
records.description: USGS viewer for topographic maps, the National Hydrography Dataset (streams and waterbodies), the Watershed Boundary Dataset, elevation and imagery.

records.title: USGS Water Data for Kentucky
records.description: USGS monitoring locations in Kentucky with streamflow, water-level and water-quality observations.
records.primary_use: Finding USGS monitoring locations and data
records.check_detail: The site refused the automated check (HTTP 403); confirm in a browser

records.title: Cropland Data Layer Viewer (CropScape)
records.description: Annual, crop-specific land-cover maps derived from satellite imagery. Useful for describing what is grown in a watershed — but mapped crops near a stream do not, by themselves, show that runoff reaches it.
records.primary_use: Mapping agricultural land cover by year

records.title: Web Soil Survey
records.description: Official soil survey maps and interpretations: soil types, drainage class, erodibility and hydrologic soil group for any area of interest.

records.title: Learn about Harmful Algae, Cyanobacteria and Cyanotoxins
records.description: Authoritative introduction to what cyanobacteria are, how blooms form, which toxins they can produce, and how people and animals are exposed.
records.primary_use: Background reading on cyanobacteria and toxins

records.title: Indicators: Cyanotoxins (Microcystin)
records.description: How the National Aquatic Resource Surveys measure microcystins and how the results are interpreted against health-based benchmarks.

records.title: National Aquatic Resource Surveys
records.description: EPA's statistically designed national surveys of lakes, rivers and streams, wetlands and coasts — the reference point for comparing a local result with national conditions.

records.title: How's My Waterway?
records.description: Plain-language view of state-reported assessment results for waters near any address, including whether waters are listed as impaired and why.
records.primary_use: Checking assessment status of nearby waters

records.title: Cyanobacteria Assessment Network Application (CyAN app)
records.description: Satellite-derived estimates of cyanobacteria in larger U.S. lakes and reservoirs. Pixels are hundreds of meters wide, so it can say something about Lake Cumberland but nothing about a small stream.
records.primary_use: Remote-sensing bloom estimates for large lakes

records.title: Harmful Algal Bloom (HAB)-Associated Illness
records.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
records.description: Public-health guidance on illnesses linked to harmful algal blooms in people and animals, including symptoms and how to avoid exposure.

records.title: National Field Manual for the Collection of Water-Quality Data
records.description: The USGS standard procedures for collecting and processing water-quality samples and field measurements — temperature, pH, conductivity, dissolved oxygen, turbidity — including calibration and quality control.

records.title: Laboratories that Analyze for Cyanobacteria and Cyanotoxins
records.description: EPA's starting point for finding laboratories that identify cyanobacteria and measure cyanotoxins. Toxin testing for portal projects goes through qualified laboratories, never the teaching lab.
records.primary_use: Arranging cyanobacteria identification or toxin analysis

records.title: PubMed
records.description: Database of biomedical and life-science literature. Strong for cyanotoxins, toxicology and microbiology; search terms such as "microcystin AND Daphnia" work well.

records.title: PubMed Central (PMC)
records.description: Free full-text archive of open-access journal articles — use it to read the full paper when PubMed shows only an abstract.

records.title: USGS Publications Warehouse
records.description: Every USGS report and journal article, free to read. The place to find Scientific Investigations Reports and Open-File Reports on water quality and cyanobacteria.

records.title: Google Scholar
records.description: Broad scholarly search across journals, theses and reports, with "cited by" links for following a topic forward in time. Always confirm details against the publisher or a DOI.
records.check_detail: The site refused the automated check (HTTP 429); confirm in a browser

records.title: Crossref Metadata Search
records.description: Look up a DOI or search by title to confirm authors, year, journal, volume and pages. Every DOI in this portal's bibliography was checked against Crossref.

records.title: GBIF — Global Biodiversity Information Facility
records.description: Open global database of species occurrence records from museums, surveys and community science, searchable by taxon and map area.
records.check_detail: The site refused the automated check (HTTP 403); confirm in a browser

records.title: AlgaeBase
records.organization: AlgaeBase (M.D. Guiry & G.M. Guiry, University of Galway)
records.description: Taxonomic and nomenclatural database for algae, including cyanobacteria. Use it to check current genus names and synonyms (for example, Anabaena → Dolichospermum for planktonic species).

records.title: Google Earth (web)
records.description: Aerial imagery and 3-D terrain, including historical imagery for some areas. Good for reconnaissance; imagery interpretations are preliminary until confirmed in the field.

records.title: QGIS
records.description: Free, open-source desktop GIS for combining stream lines, watershed boundaries, land cover and field points, and for real calculations such as land-cover percentages within a delineated basin.
records.primary_use: Spatial analysis on your own computer

records.title: iNaturalist
records.organization: iNaturalist (California Academy of Sciences & National Geographic Society)
records.description: Community platform for photographing and documenting organisms. Useful for macroinvertebrates and riparian plants; it is not a substitute for microscopic or molecular identification of cyanobacteria.

records.title: Water Quality Portal
records.organization: USGS, EPA and the National Water Quality Monitoring Council
records.description: Single search across water-quality data from federal, state, tribal and local agencies. Searchable by hydrologic unit — for example, the Lower Pitman Creek subwatershed that contains Allen Branch.
records.primary_use: Finding existing monitoring locations and data

records.title: USGS ScienceBase
records.description: Repository of USGS scientific datasets with full metadata — where the data behind many USGS reports can be downloaded.
